name: Detroit Edible | 100mg Crispy Treats | Cookies & Cream
description: Cannabis cookies are generally made with cannabis-infused butter and are available in a wide variety of flavors. Because edibles are digested and absorbed by your stomach and liver, the activation is often longer than other consumption methods, taking on average 45 minutes, and sometimes up to 2 hours. It is important to start low and slow when consuming edibles so you don't over do it. Take extra caution to ensure edibles are out of the reach of children.
